title: De-Pay
tagline: A simple peer to peer payment Dapp that supports multiple tokens
description: This project is proposed to be a simple peer-to-peer payment decentralized application running on the polygon blockchain. This dapp supports multiple token payment - tokens that are on the polygon chain which would be used in peer-to-peer transactions such as car pooling, housing payments or group collateral.
how_its_made: I built this using truffle, solidity and Moralis API with the proposed dapp written in typescript/javascript to be deployed on the polygon mainnet. Moralis API benefit my project because it made not only the API call easier, but also the dapp integration on react. I figured out how to properly call the Moralis API. I didn't work in a team, I hacked solo and I'm impressed at the progress I made on the smart contract though I'm yet to complete the fronted to specification.
